snippet.title: Mosaica: Arboreal - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
If "Diablo" and "Cookie Clicker" had a cute goblincore baby. An enchanting RPG mosaic puzzle where every mouse click evokes the mysterious power of nature. Solve puzzles using a suite of abilities. Level up, chill, unwind, repeat. Grow and evolve, one soothing victory at a time. Inspired by the writings of Polish tree channeler Weronika Dąbrowska, this Naturepunk journey invites you to... “Forget yourself, so that you may remember yourself.”

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192050/Mosaica_Arboreal/
